noise.qualification: Exact common mean map and objective for all p transfer the existing oracle fits and calibration metrics. These are the same256 realizations, with new whole-contact readouts evaluated here.

identifiability.qualification: Sampled full-range monotonic curves, noiseless objective profiles and endpoint/interior fit recovery; not an interval proof or a claim about arbitrary noisy objectives.

reference_refinement.scope: Every graded setting and all6 calibration settings, each at all3 listed parameters; field, time, settling and measurement-period variations are separate.

weak_limits.scope: Author-only limits; fixed task g=.5 and tau[.2,1.2].
